annotation.justification: The clause provides a clear directive: if any fragment of an IPv6 datagram is determined to be an overlapping fragment during reassembly, the entire datagram and all its fragments must be silently discarded. There is no ambiguity in the action required (discard the datagram) or the condition (detection of an overlapping fragment). The language is precise and does not allow for multiple materially different interpretations.
